LanguageData.RL_ExpandShaftHelp: Open the next floor at this shaft. Miners clear real rock at the exit and an adjacent construction position, then a station blueprint is placed at the exit. Supply and build it normally. Until completion, enabled source stops provide slow construction access. Canceling stops mining and cancels the unfinished station; mined rock and floors remain.
LanguageData.RL_ShaftAlreadyConnected: A station already occupies the next floor.
LanguageData.RL_ShaftNeedsWorkCell: The exit needs a supported adjacent construction position, clear of buildings.
